memos.scout:
The honest case for buying is weak, and I would not recommend it.

What the brief shows in favor: the coin is alive at 30.8 minutes, up 160% over 30 minutes, with 743 buyers and 404.9 SOL bought in the last 15 minutes. Buyer share is spread out (top 5 buyers hold 11.5% at graduation), and there is no airdrop dump or operator-backed signature. Pool depth of 145 SOL is reasonable.

What argues against it, more strongly: the coin is down 38.8% from its 30-minute high, and in the last 15 minutes sell volume (403.5 SOL) nearly matched buy volume (404.9 SOL), with net flow of just 1.43 SOL. Sellers (722) almost equal buyers (743), and the early sell-to-buy ratio of 0.84 shows heavy early distribution. The return over the last 15 minutes is -9.6%. Demand is churning rather than building, and the 30-60 minute window is where this pattern usually resolves downward. The class is unresolved and the curve metrics are missing, so I can't rule out bundling or a dump.

Verdict: no buy. The momentum that made this coin attractive has already faded into a dip with balanced flow, and the base rates for this stage do not favor entry at a $20 ticket once fees of 1.4-5.1% are included.
